def rotate_matrix(m):
    """
    Rotate a square matrix 90 degrees clockwise.

    Args:
        m (list): A square matrix (a list of equal-length lists).

    Returns:
        list: A new matrix rotated 90 degrees clockwise.
    """
    if not m or not all(len(row) == len(m) for row in m):
        return []

    return [list(reversed(i)) for i in zip(*m)]

def slugify(title):
    """Turn a title into a URL slug."""
    title = ''.join(c for c in title if c.isalnum() or c.isspace() or c == '-')
    title = title.lower()
    while '--' in title:
        title = title.replace('--', '-')
    title = title.strip('-')
    return title
